sql:
SELECT ra.year, AVG(strftime('%s', r.time) - strftime('%s', '00:00:00')) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE r.position = 1 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY ra.year
